messages.subject: Mplus code for moderated mediation
parts:
Dear list,
 
I am trying the 5 models in the following paper:
 
Preacher, K. J., Rucker, D. D., & Hayes, A. F. (2007). Addressing moderated mediation hypotheses: Theory, methods, and prescriptions. Multivariate Behavioral Research, 42, 185-227.
 
The corresponding Mplus code can be found here:
http://www.afhayes.com/public/mplus1to5.pdf
 
I am having trouble to understand the new parameter defined in the MODEL CONSTRAINT part, for example, for model 1, the MODEL CONSTRAINT part looks like:
 
MODEL CONSTRAINT: 
      new (ind xmodval); 
      xmodval = -1; 
      ind = a1*(b1+b2*xmodval); 
 
My question is:
 
What is this xmodval? What is its function? Why a value should be give to it? The b2 is already the path coefficient of the interaction term involving the moderator, why the b2 should be multiplied with something else?
 
Thank you very much.
 
Best regards,
 
ya
